{{Quote|I hate domestic disturbance calls. The people get into knock-down drag-outs with one another, then we show up to restore order and they come after us with vibroblades.|Dobi|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Dobi''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] belonging to the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] unit loyal to the corrupt [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she and her partner, [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Vitkins]], were called in to a small dwelling to investigate the reports of domestic disturbance. They soon found themselves caught in a trap by the [[Quad-Linked Militant Pacifists]], a fictitious terrorist organization that served as a front for [[Wraith Squadron]], a Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit investigating Thaal. Dobi and Vitkins were both tied up after they fell for the trap, though they were later discovered by later parties of Pop-Dogs who freed them.<ref name="MK" />
